// Arcade versus map STARSHIP — generated by tools/mapgen/genship.py, do not hand-edit.
//
// A ship lying on the diagonal, stern bottom left, bow top right; space (outside) all round the hull. Not
// mirrored: the hangar and the bridge are different ground, and every point is about as far from either start.
// Corridors are street, the bays floor. Nothing here is for sale.
//
// Tiles    #  wall (hull and bulkheads)   .  floor (bays)   _  street (corridors and ducts)
//          ,  space (nobody walks there)   T  pillar and  x  crate (block walking and bullets)
// Objects  1 and 2 are where the two teams start; A, B and C are the capture points;
//          b  steam (walkable, hides you from enemies more than 2 tiles away)
//          t s d o r c  furniture: console, locker, bunk (two cells), reactor, canister, cargo —
//                       each blocks walking and bullets like a crate
